d: Democratic leader James Talarico has called on Democrats to work with President Donald Trump, saying Americans cannot wait two years for change. Talarico said Democrats should make the final two years of Trump's presidency the most productive in American history. He also suggested helping Trump achieve the recognition and legacy associated with former President Lyndon B. Johnson, referencing plaques, portraits and busts. Stressing that the moment was bigger than party politics, Talarico urged leaders to look beyond the red team and blue team. His remarks highlight his call for cooperation…
